bundle.shortDescription: Chat with your own documents, fully local.
bundle.longDescription: Enterprise RAG is a local-first Retrieval-Augmented Generation desktop app. Upload your own documents (PDF, Excel/CSV, images, text, URLs), index them into a local vector store, and chat with them. Answers are grounded only in your content, with source citations. No data leaves your machine unless you choose a cloud LLM provider.
